slide_title: Matrix Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (N- Samples)

bullets: Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix

layout.arrangement: Title spans the top in red with 'Matrix' in blue; slide number '17' in a yellow circle at top-right. Upper-middle: a blue-bordered box containing four vertical sample vectors X_1, X_2, ..., X_n with labels 'N Training Samples' to its left. Upper-right: a 'Remember' box with equation, and below it an 'In General: N >>> d' box. Bottom-left: a large red-bordered box containing the full matrix equation Y = X W expanded. Bottom-right: a red-bordered box with 'Y = X W' and the 'Where:' definitions, connected by a red arrow from the matrix box.

regions.name: title bar
regions.content: Slide title in red/blue, page number 17 in yellow circle at right

regions.name: sample vectors box
regions.content: Blue-bordered box with four colored vertical vectors X_1 (yellow), X_2 (cyan), ellipsis, X_n (magenta), each with x entries and y label at bottom

regions.name: remember box
regions.content: Light-blue box: 'Remember' in red italic, equation y = W^T X = X^T W with W in blue and X in red

layout.hierarchy: Title largest in bold red; equations and box headers next in mixed red/blue bold; matrix entries and labels smaller black text; color-coded vectors (yellow, cyan, magenta) draw the eye to the sample columns.

visual_elements.description: Four vertical column vectors representing training samples: X_1 (yellow highlight) containing x_11, x_12, .., x_1d with y_1 below; X_2 (cyan) containing x_21, x_22, .., x_2d with y_2 below; an ellipsis column of '...'; X_n (magenta) containing x_n1, x_n2, .., x_nd with y_n below. Labels X_1, X_2, ..., X_n above each column. Enclosed in a blue rectangular border.
Light blue box titled 'Remember' (red italic) containing equation y = W^T X = X^T W, with W in blue and X in red; a small cursor arrow points at the equation.
Beige/tan box with text 'In General: N >>> d' where N and d are red.

Matrix equation inside red border: left side is column vector [y_1 (yellow), y_2 (cyan), ..., y_n (magenta)] labeled N x 1; equals sign; large matrix with rows [1 x_11 x_12 ... x_1d] (yellow highlight), [1 x_21 x_22 ... x_2d] (cyan), [1 .... .... .... ....], [1 x_n1 x_n2 ... x_nd] (magenta), labeled N x d+1; times column vector [1, w_2, w_2, ..., w_d] labeled d+1 x 1.
Red outlined right-pointing arrow connecting the matrix equation box to the definitions box.
Red-bordered box: 'Y = X W' with Y underlined, X in blue, W in red; below 'Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix' and 'Y_{N x 1} is labels vector' with subscripts in red.
Yellow circle with black border containing slide number '17'.

imagery: Small green squiggle/scribble marks under the title at top-left and near top-right (hand-drawn annotation style)
Small mouse-cursor arrow icon pointing at the Remember equation
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout; title bold with 'Matrix' in blue and remainder in red; mathematical notation in italic serif-like math font; 'Remember' in red italic; color-coding (blue for W/X matrix symbols, red for X/W and subscripts) used consistently for emphasis; no numbered bullets.
animation_state: Fully built slide; no partial reveals apparent. A cursor arrow near the Remember box suggests live annotation during lecture.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#DDDDDD) with a thin dark-red border framing the whole slide. 2. Top: add title text 'Matrix Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (N- Samples)' — 'Matrix' in blue, rest in bold red. Add yellow circle with '17' at top-right. 3. Add small green squiggle marks beneath title left and near top-right. 4. Upper-center: draw blue-bordered rectangle; inside place four vertical rounded columns labeled X_1, X_2, ..., X_n on top; fill X_1 column yellow with entries x_11, x_12, .., x_1d and y_1 below; X_2 cyan with x_21, x_22, .., x_2d and y_2; ellipsis column of dots; X_n magenta with x_n1, x_n2, .., x_nd and y_n. 5. Left of that box, red bold text 'N Training Samples'. 6. Upper-right: light-blue box with red italic 'Remember' and equation 'y = W^T X = X^T W' (W blue, X red); add small cursor arrow beneath. 7. Below it: beige box 'In General: N >>> d' with N and d red. 8. Bottom-left: red-bordered box containing matrix equation: column vector [y_1, y_2, ..., y_n] (rows highlighted yellow, cyan, magenta) labeled 'N x 1', equals sign, matrix with first column of 1s and rows [1 x_11 x_12 ... x_1d] (yellow), [1 x_21 x_22 ... x_2d] (cyan), [1 .... .... .... ....], [1 x_n1 x_n2 ... x_nd] (magenta) labeled 'N x d+1', times vector [1, w_2, w_2, ..., w_d] labeled 'd+1 x 1'. 9. Draw red right-pointing arrow from this box to the right box. 10. Bottom-right: red-bordered box with 'Y = X W' (Y underlined black, X blue, W red), then 'Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix' and 'Y_{N x 1} is labels vector' with red subscripts.
